title: Untersuchungen zum Einsatz hochauflösender bathymetrischer LIDAR Daten in der2D-Abflusssimulation und Habitatmodellierung
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: In the present thesis, the use of high-resolution bathymetric survey data from Airborne LIDAR Bathymetry (ALB) in hydrodynamic-numerical (HN) modelling and physically based habitat modelling is investigated. Two near-natural river reaches at the river Lech in Bavaria and the river Ahr in South Tyrol were exemplary used therefore.
